steps.heading: Arrays, not lists
steps.body: A NumPy array looks like a Python list but supports fast, element-wise math with no explicit loop, pandas itself is built on top of NumPy arrays.

steps.heading: Vectorized arithmetic
steps.caption: Every element is multiplied at once, no for-loop needed.

steps.heading: Boolean masking
steps.body: arr > 25 produces a same-shaped array of True/False, which you can then use to filter arr itself, the exact same idea as pandas boolean indexing.

steps.heading: Filter with a mask
steps.caption: You'll practice array creation, arithmetic, masking, aggregation, and reshaping in the cards that follow.
